item.title: Using claude-code on a Server
item.description: The same applies to a desktop environment. 1. Prepare the node.js environment Install nvm 1 curl -o- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvm-sh/nvm/v0.40.3/install.sh | bash 1 2 echo 'export NVM_DIR="$([ -z "${XDG_CONFIG_HOME-}" ] && printf %s "${HOME}/.nvm" || printf %s "${XDG_CONFIG_HOME}/nvm")"' >> ~/.bashrc echo '[ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && \. "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"' >> ~/.bashrc 1 source

item.title: Using Gemini CLI on a Server
item.description: 1. Get the Project ID and API Key Visit https://aistudio.google.com/apikey Get the project ID and API key, and set them as environment variables 1 2 echo "export GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT=" >> ~/.bashrc echo "export GEMINI_API_KEY=" >> ~/.bashrc 1 source ~/.bashrc 2.
